observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A spacious, bright room with large glass windows overlooking a city street, wooden floors, performance art setting
observation.dancers: Two men, performing as a couple
observation.formation_and_space: A couple dancing together, moving across the polished wooden floor in various directions
observation.posture: Upright, torso engaged, knees slightly soft to allow smooth weight shifts and pivots
observation.footwork: Stepping, crosses, sliding steps, weight shifts on the beat; cannot clearly see exact toe-heel articulation due to video resolution and lighting
observation.arms_and_hands: Held in a standard embrace hold, one arm linked and hands clasped together, framing the upper body
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso connected and rotating together in tandem, hips moving as part of stepping and pivots
observation.partnering: Close couple embrace with constant contact, alternating who leads and follows throughout the performance
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Turns, pivots, low leg extensions, sweeps (ganchos/boleos as visible in profile)
observation.costume_and_props: One dancer in a black shirt and black trousers, the other in a white shirt with decorative collar/cuffs and black trousers; no props
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot articulation, micro-weight shifts, and instantaneous lead-follow signals are obscured by camera angles and distance

signature_moments.what: A close embrace pivot turn with synchronized steps around each other
A swept leg extension while maintaining close embrace and posture
A lifted pose where one dancer supports the other's extended leg position
A low sweeping leg extension (boleo) rotating around the standing leg
